title: cynoglossum densum
intro: Cynoglossum densum, commonly known as Chinese forget-me-not, is a flowering plant that belongs to the borage family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an anti-oxidant. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum densum include its anti-inflammatory, anti-bacterial, and anti-viral properties, which can help to treat a variety of conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Cynoglossum densum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
